description: Source code for a library implementing Generic Netlink protocol functions, including message construction, parsing, validation, and socket communication.

methods.name: genl_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the generic netlink socket.

methods.name: genl_send_simple
methods.description: Constructs and sends a simple generic netlink message with specified command and version.

methods.name: genlmsg_valid_hdr
methods.description: Validates the header of a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_validate
methods.description: Validates a generic netlink message against a policy.

methods.name: genlmsg_parse
methods.description: Parses attributes from a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the data payload of a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_len
methods.description: Returns the length of the payload in a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_attrdata
methods.description: Returns pointer to attribute data within a message.

methods.name: genlmsg_attrlen
methods.description: Returns length of attribute data within a message.

methods.name: genlmsg_put
methods.description: Adds a generic netlink header to a netlink message and returns pointer to user data.
